name: domorium
description: Domorium GEDCOM editing tools for the web, Visual Studio Code, and JetBrains IDEs

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w packages/language-server && npm run build -w packages/codemirror
scripts.check:conformance: npm run build -w packages/validator && node scripts/check-conformance.mjs
scripts.check:typescript: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:run
scripts.check: npm run check:typescript && npm run check:docs && npm run check:jetbrains
